stemBlocks: The resistors in the following four circuits are identical. The cells are identical and have no internal resistance. Each cell can supply the same total amount of energy at a constant voltage before becoming exhausted. $t_1, t_2, t_3$ and $t_4$ are the lengths of time after which the cells in circuits 1, 2, 3 and 4, respectively, become exhausted. Which comparison of $t_1, t_2, t_3$ and $t_4$ is correct?
